none: PAS NLM-3E4AC3: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus, probably of Constantine I (306-337), Soli Invicto Comiti issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bust draped right. Obverse inscription: [--]TINVS AVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left; indeterminate symbol in right field. Reverse inscription: [SOLI INVICTO COMITI]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter (in excess of): 20.2mm, Weight: 1.63gms, die axis: 6
